title: The Sign of the Four
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: A mysterious inheritance draws Holmes and Watson into a trail of stolen treasure.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

longDescription: Clues, testimony and conflicting appearances invite you to examine what the characters believe they know. The pleasure lies in following the investigation and noticing details as they acquire new significance. This is a good choice for readers who enjoy atmosphere, deduction and a steadily developing puzzle.

authorInfo.bio: Arthur Conan Doyle was a Scottish-born physician and author who created Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson. His detective stories made close observation central to the mystery genre. Beyond Holmes, he wrote historical fiction and adventure stories, including The Lost World.
authorInfo.edition: Complete collection of twelve stories. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.
